# The positions table's and Advanced sheet's bugs (S4 U3), each on a fresh page of the fixture.
# "ok" is what must hold; "BUG" is the bug, and what the page did.

## B4 · another screen's positions are never move or paired targets
ok   position offers no position bound to another screen
ok   col:partner:paired offers no position bound to another screen
ok   col:partner:secondPaired offers no position bound to another screen

## B5 · Tool change is drawn exactly where flowspec lets the mode carry changeover_evac_nodes
ok   every row

## B6 · the row's "N set" is the sheet's own total
ok   every row of Style B

## F15 · Board order only on a loader position; Curtain required only where the node has a curtain
ok   Board order is drawn on no line-mode position
ok   Curtain required is drawn exactly on the curtained position

## B7 · the key-route picker offers no waypoint already on the route
ok   POS_A3 via:0 (LM_2 of LM_2 › LM_3)
ok   POS_A3 via:1 (LM_3 of LM_2 › LM_3)

## F26 · a swap-mode change keeps what the new mode uses and says what it dropped
ok   inbound staging STG_1 is kept (2-Robot Swap uses it)
ok   outbound staging STG_2 is dropped (2-Robot Swap forbids it)
ok   the page says outbound staging STG_2 was dropped
ok   the words: "2‑Robot Swap does not use Outbound staging STG_2: dropped from POS_A5."

## U3 · Auto reorder on the row: off on a new position of either role; Set turns it on at the point; Off turns it off
ok   a new consume position reads off
ok   a new produce position reads off
ok   Set 15 writes reorder_point 15 and auto_reorder on; the cell reads 15
ok   Off writes auto_reorder off and keeps the point; the cell reads off
ok   the reorder point's sub-label speaks of the bin, not of what is left in it: "units in the bin when the next one is requested"

## R2 · a column no row uses is not drawn; a row that does not use a drawn column leaves its cell empty
ok   every mode on the table: Paired core node is drawn
ok   only POS_A3 two_robot, POS_A4 two_robot, POS_A5 single_robot, POS_A6 single_robot left: Paired core node is not drawn

ok   no card says "on deck for" or "paired with"
ok   a pair card says "Paired core node"

## + Add a position is on the box's head line, above the headings, not under the rows and the bar

## Advanced · a flipped switch is typed work, so Escape and the backdrop ask first
